speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying; the winter worsening aligns with cold air sensitivity, but your lack of wheezing and chest tightness makes typical asthma less likely. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Bronchitis with Occupational Exposure (Construction Dust/Fumes).
